thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: How do I build a morning routine that actually sticks?
thread_summary: Look for someone who keeps abandoning morning routines or wants a simple one.
text: Start smaller than feels useful. Pick one anchor that already happens, like making your first drink, and attach one tiny action to it for two weeks: water, 5 minutes of sunlight, or 10 pushups. Add the second habit only after the first stops needing willpower. Most routines fail because they have 7 steps on day one. Keeping the wake-up time the same on weekends also does a lot of the work.
why: Routine building is our brand's frame (rituals), but this is pure help.
